## What does this change?

<!-- A sentence or two. Closes #123 if it resolves an issue. -->

## Type

- [ ] New module (I claimed it in an issue: #___)
- [ ] Improvement or correction to an existing module
- [ ] Typo / broken link / outdated command
- [ ] App or API change
- [ ] Docs or tooling

## For content changes

- [ ] I **ran** every command and code sample (on: ______ )
- [ ] Factual changes cite a **source** (link in the description or in *Further reading & sources*)
- [ ] New modules follow the [module recipe](https://github.com/TapanKumarBarik/Backend-roadmap#what-a-great-module-looks-like) and end with *Further reading & sources* and a *Next* link
- [ ] I previewed it locally, or it's a small edit I'm confident about
- [ ] If AI helped, I verified the output and say so here: ______

## For app or API changes

- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] I tested it (what and how): ______
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots (light **and** dark)
- [ ] No secrets or personal data are committed
